title: Welcome to TTCG News!
body: This is the first official post on the TTCG News Board, here we will share any exciting new stuff about the app, as well as any new version that ayou can download on our website!

title: TTCG News officially live!
body: We are happy to announce that, after 3 months of work, TTCG News is finally up and running. The Github page has also now been uploaded. Here we will post any updates or changes to the app, as well as any important news about the world. We are very excited to launch this feature, and hope you all like it!

title: Russian drones in Belgian airspace!
body: BREAKING NEWS: Recent reports indicate that several unidentified drones of Russian origin were detected entering Belgian airspace. According to official sources, the aircraft were monitored by Belgian defense systems and escorted away without any incidents. Authorities emphasized that there is no current threat to public safety. An investigation is ongoing to determine the drones' exact purpose and flight path. We will continue to monitor updates and share new information as it becomes available.

title: TTCG Connect entering Alpha!
body: The TTCG Connect App is entering its alpha stage, and exiting the pre-alpha! We are very excited to finally launch the app and provide users with the Swiss Army knife of iOS apps!

title: TTCG Connect officially in Alpha!
body: We are pleased to FINALLY announce, that after a 2 week delay to to issues with revamping the login system, TTCG Connect has finally entered the Alpha stage and a public release will soon follow! This has now officially been 4 months in the making. And we are truly sorry you all had to wait so long. The release is expected to follow on the 15th of December 2025.

title: Release delayed to 20/12...
body: We are truly sorry to make this post, however due to some issues on the developer's end, we had to push the estimated release date back to the 20th of December for the iOS version,and the Android release shortly after on the 22nd. We are truly sorry for this delay, however itis for the best, as we don't want to release an unfinished app.
